Bagbazar Durga Puja, North Kolkata. One frame, the whole family: Maa Durga with Lakshmi, Saraswati, Kartik and Ganesh, in the traditional ek-chala style.

Bagbazar Sarbojanin Durgotsav is one of Kolkata's oldest community pujos, now more than a hundred years old. The city has moved on to giant theme pandals, but Bagbazar still brings Maa home the way it always has.

Sabeki or theme, which side are you on? 👇

North Kolkata pandal hopping route for Durga Puja 2026: 17 pandals, 11.3 km, one night 🚶

Start at Sovabazar Metro. Kumartuli, Ahiritola, Bagbazar Sarbojanin, Sovabazar Rajbari, then east to Hatibagan and Telengabagan: 17 pujos, about 11 km and 16,500 steps, in the order you'd actually walk them.

Mahalaya is today. Eight nights to Shashthi.

Comment "PUJO" and we'll DM you every route.
